comments: In [FUFWUVQQ]: 306, Mathes shows that, in Tāranātha's list of the transmission, bCom ldan ral gri replaces Ze'u Chos kyi rgyal mtshan, which seems to suggest that they are identical. It is however unlikely that this Chos kyi rgyal mtshan can be identified with bCom ldan ral gri (ID: 4006), who is never referred to with the clan name "ze'u."
name: ze'u chos kyi rgyal mtshan
